import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv', parse_dates=['BillingPeriodStart','ChargePeriodStart','ChargePeriodEnd'])

print(df['SubAccountName'].value_counts())
print(df['ChargeCategory'].value_counts())
sub = df[df['SubAccountName']=='prod-core']
print(sub['BillingPeriodStart'].min(), sub['BillingPeriodStart'].max())
# filter to 2026-09 billing period
mask = (df['BillingPeriodStart'] >= '2026-09-01') & (df['BillingPeriodStart'] < '2026-10-01') & (df['SubAccountName']=='prod-core')
s = df[mask]
print(s.shape)
print(s.groupby('ServiceName')['BilledCost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))
